subject: Co-deploy pilot: Redwood + Pinecone + Nebula - S3/pgvector fallback test
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah@nebula-consulting.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: pinecone-sales@pinecone.io
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal - co-deploy test for S3 fallback + pgvector

Hi Soojin,

Following up from our quick intro last month — Nebula Consulting helps enterprise customers stitch vector DBs and object stores into resilient retrieval layers. We have an interested joint customer (Acme.ai) that wants to validate a co-deployment topology where Redwood routes queries to Pinecone, falls back to a pgvector S3-backed index, and has an integrated cold tier on S3 for older vectors.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 6-week co-deploy pilot with Pinecone + Nebula + Acme to validate correctness and operator handoffs? We think the scope should include:
- end-to-end query flow validation (latency and correctness across 3 replicas)
- S3 cold-tiering and rehydration workflows
- pgvector index sync/backfill for failover
- a short runbook that lays out fallback decision points and metrics to watch

We can supply a small dataset, a Nebula engineer (Derek) to act as on-call for the pilot, and a draft PoC scope. Budget for the pilot will be covered by Acme; this is primarily an engineering validation.

Attached a one-pager scope (nebula_poc_scope.pdf).

Would love to get Redwood and Pinecone aligned on next steps and a quick tech sync this week.

Thanks,
Sarah
Principal, Partnerships | Nebula Consulting
--
nebula_poc_scope.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@nebula-consulting.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal - co-deploy test for S3 fallback + pgvector

Sarah — thanks for the clear scope and the attached one-pager. Redwood is interested in a lightweight, time-boxed pilot like this. Quick answers + next steps: 

- High level: agree with the scope. Tech team will want to validate two failure modes (Pinecone outage and S3-read latency spike) and the correctness of fallback scoring.
- Timeline: we can start planning immediately; engineering can reserve a 6-week window starting Oct 4.
- Contacts: looping in Vanessa (partnerships lead) and Ben (connector/ops lead). Laura from Platform Partnerships will help with commercial/POC contracting.

Action items I propose:
1) Tech kickoff (1hr) next Tue 9/15 — attendees: Soojin, Vanessa, Ben, Alex (Pinecone), Derek (Nebula), Acme tech lead.
2) Shared runbook draft and acceptance criteria by 9/20 (Nebula to propose, Redwood to comment).
3) Data access checklist and sample dataset delivery by Acme by 9/24.

Ben — can you confirm Redwood infra needs (GPU/no-GPU, test index sizing, S3 permissions) and whether we should prepare a temporary pgvector sandbox?
Vanessa — will reach out separately on contracting and cost carveouts.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

— Soojin
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <pinecone-sales@pinecone.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah@nebula-consulting.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal - co-deploy test for S3 fallback + pgvector

Thanks all — Pinged to confirm Pinecone alignment. A few technical notes from our side that will help the kickoff: 

- For deterministic failover tests, we recommend a shadow index with identical configuration (dimensionality, metric) so we can compare vector scores side-by-side. Pinecone can host a small sandbox index for the duration.
- We will provide an endpoint-level health-check hook that Redwood can probe; for simulated outage we can flip the endpoint to return 503 for a short window.
- S3 cold-tier behavior: we want to make sure rehydration is instrumented in the runbook (time-to-availability SLA expected).

Attaching a lightweight connector diagram I sketched (redwood_connector_diagram_v1.png).

Alex Rivera
Partnerships, Pinecone
pinecone-sales@pinecone.io
--

Subject: Re: Pilot proposal - co-deploy test for S3 fallback + pgvector

Great — thanks Alex and Sarah. Confirming the kickoff tomorrow Tue 9/15 09:00 PT (calendar invite to follow). Quick pre-kickoff checklist: 

- Nebula: final runbook draft and one-pager (Sarah) — due EOD 9/14.
- Pinecone: sandbox index and health-check flip instructions (Alex) — available at kickoff.
- Acme: sample dataset (Derek) and S3 access token (scoped to test bucket).
- Redwood (Ben): prepare pgvector sandbox and instrumentation hooks, and a minimal A/B harness to compare ranking across fallback.
- Commercial (Vanessa/Laura): draft MOU for pilot and statement of success (commercials to be finalized before production).

I'll capture the mutual action plan in a shared doc during the kickoff and assign owners. If anyone has blockers before tomorrow please flag them in a reply to this thread.

See you all tomorrow.

— Soojin
